photos.alt: Candid over-the-shoulder view from the INSYNC run club crowd toward the 'Layers SUPERFOOD BAR' wall sign, with friends seated at a bistro table
The whole INSYNC run club gathers in front of the Layers storefront after the first run of the semester, two men kneeling in front
Three run-club members toast with two Layers smoothies - a layered pink-and-blue cup and a solid pink cup - on a sunny Berkeley street corner
Candid in-motion shot from the run: a woman in silver over-ear headphones and a blush sports bra jogs toward camera grinning and waving
Vertical, sharp shot of the white Layers corner storefront with its round blade sign, black lamps and wordmark
Vertical shot of the INSYNC run crowd gathering outside the shop in low golden sun
Inside Layers during the INSYNC run club visit: warm late-afternoon light, globe pendants, the acrylic Smoothies/Bowls menu wall
Faceless close-up of three runners outside the shop holding cups of a pink berry smoothie with lavender-blue swirls
Three young women in athleisure smile warmly in front of the Layers storefront after the Project.eee run
Two women hug and laugh outside the shop, one in sunglasses and the other in a green zip-up with a big genuine laugh
Two men stand shoulder to shoulder outside the white stucco Layers storefront after the first Project.eee run club
Two She Runs Berkeley runners with Layers bowls at a café table outside the shop, on a busy Saturday morning
She Runs Berkeley runners holding Layers cups inside the shop, under the globe pendants
Three She Runs Berkeley runners smiling with their Layers bowls inside the shop
The INSYNC run club gathered outside Layers on Channing Way after an afternoon run
The run club after an October run, gathered outside Layers with their smoothies and bowls
Runners crowding the doorway of Layers after an October run
